full_combined_prompt: Exactly 8 seconds, 9:16 vertical aspect ratio, photorealistic cinematic render, smooth continuous motion, no cuts, maximum cinematic realism. Second 1 [0:00-0:01] — HUD Popup Text: "STEP 1: ALIEN WORLD AWAKENING" — The colossal ark awakens as billions of sensor halos ignite across its crown and spine, autonomous drone constellations form planetary-scale geometric patterns, plasma conduits pulse like stellar arteries, and gravity fields stabilize the entire flooded landscape. Second 2 [0:01-0:02] — HUD Popup Text: "STEP 2: HYPERDIMENSIONAL HARVEST" — Impossible harvesting arms unfold across continental distances, their alien claws gently sweep through innumerable rice fields, extracting crops with sub-millimeter precision while autonomous drones coordinate every movement as a single intelligence. Second 3 [0:02-0:03] — HUD Popup Text: "STEP 3: COSMIC BELLY FACTORY" — Vast streams of harvested rice plunge into the titan's interior, entering planet-sized threshing cylinders, recursive processing chambers and galaxy-like cyclone separators where grain, straw and husk become perfectly separated matter streams. Second 4 [0:03-0:04] — HUD Popup Text: "STEP 4: QUANTUM CREATION PURIFICATION" — Electromagnetic fields, artificial gravity wells and hyper-dimensional lattices manipulate individual particles, cyclone galaxies remove every microscopic impurity, and artificial-star thermal loops dry each grain through controlled quantum energy. Second 5 [0:04-0:05] — HUD Popup Text: "STEP 5: INFINITE GRAIN RESERVOIRS" — Purified grain becomes a radiant cascade flowing into endless alien storage vaults, colossal reservoirs synchronize across dimensions while each individual grain is positioned, stabilized and preserved inside a glowing gravitational lattice. Seconds 6-8 [0:05-0:08]: HUD text completely fades; the camera performs a continuous impossible-scale descent from the cosmic titan into its belly, through alien processing architecture, and finally reaches a maximum close-up of a single harvested particle/grain suspended beside a colossal quantum mechanism, with the surrounding machinery stabilizing into a mesmerizing continuous harvesting rhythm, no cuts, no scene transition, exactly 8 seconds.
